name: handoff
description: Session handoff skill for zero-loss continuity across coding agent conversations. Generates structured context-transfer documents at session end, verifies and loads them at session start.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and resume structured session handoffs
interface.longDescription: Use Handoff to capture session context, decisions, drift-sensitive project state, friction points, and next priorities so a future agent session can resume without rediscovering the work.
defaultPrompt: Create a handoff for this session.
Fix where my handoffs are stored.
